Its repeatable verification is `python3 -I -B benchmark/scripts/split_allocate.py --check`.
[Writing review #493](reports/493.json) closes S1–S3 for the pinned synthetic design; no unchanged writing re-review is ordered.
That review reports 75 independent probes, preserved protected inputs and isolated execution, with zero native executions or agent runs.
Synthetic approval grants neither benchmark readiness nor owner method acceptance; product work remains deferred.
Updated [working memory](../journal/working-memory.md) with evidence identities, open threads and resume instructions.
Startup diagnostics were `ok`; the graph was read back and inspected for JSON structure, supported role/options, sections and edges. No shell checks were available.

## What next
Read the allocator review and linked evidence; close the bounded finding or order only its evidenced correction.
If closed, inspect actual pin evidence before suggesting a Policymaker update, then select concrete native/readiness work from paused evidence.
Avoid repeating writing review, F3 enumeration, POC reverse engineering or global gap maps.
